bootstrapMethod.unit: Whole task families, preserving their case counts
bootstrapMethod.scorer: Original scorer iteration order and RNG stream retained for the official promotion test.
bootstrapMethod.analyzer: Sorted families, seed20261028 reset per comparison; its descriptive interval can differ slightly from the official scorer draws.

artifactAudit.nativeAttestationLimit: Bounded executable/process/config/backend identity and argument-file hashes, not complete model-weight attestation.

coverageRetries.policy: First attempts stay primary. Explicit linked retries establish live coverage and are scored separately.
coverageRetries.additional503Receipt: No canonical invocation receipt available; inference start cannot be confirmed.

erratumSensitivity.reason: All ten validation prompts omit what answer is requested. Entire family excluded only in secondary sensitivity analysis; corpus and primary scores unchanged.

limitations: Family-correlated synthetic tasks; primary agent authored and reviewed rubrics.
Shared-host latency is observational, not isolated performance measurement.
First-attempt failures remain primary; successful retries only repair dispatch coverage.
Domain intervals and repeated comparisons are descriptive and not multiplicity-adjusted.
Single-family intervals cannot estimate uncertainty across unseen families.
All-case results include reused development and validation families; only the held-out split supports the frozen promotion test.
Raw direct receives fixture contents in its context; compare repository tool execution with raw_tools separately.
Observed eight raw-model critical failures are synthetic-secret echoes in one validation family; zero selected failures is not a general safety guarantee.
The corpus has1000 variants across100 families; code tests are JavaScript functional checks, not comprehensive software engineering validation.
Five invalid native responses and one503 have unknown measured usage retained as reservations; one raw-tool run also has estimated usage.
Two original tool-baseline attempts were affected by a recorded early coordinator pause; timing is observational.
Secondary semantic reviews never alter strict, tool-evidence or critical grades.
